title: A matching unit that is disabled but still active stays NERV's, so a stop can recover it
goal: NERV can stop its own unit after a disable without --now
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a matching unit with UnitFileState=disabled and ActiveState=active reads as owned; a fenced stop disables and stops it
A foreign unit still reads foreign; a loaded, disabled, inactive matching unit still reads absent
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18 from the review: one condition and one test. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-19: PR #536 merged with its committed regression; CI run 44483736523 passed every job.
